mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stabilizes or rises after its recent dip, commuter spillovers will lift retail visits within four weeks because more weekday trips create more incidental shopping and eating out.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains at or below the last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay flat or decline for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A further fall in RESIDENTIAL implies more time spent away from home, which should reduce convenience-driven retail substitution and push RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is elevated at 6.3, 6.0, 8.0, and 7.1 across the four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 8 points or continuing to rise.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 7 days after TRANSIT posts a week-on-week improvement.
